meta.normaliser: training-window (R0) truth range per component, pooled over tanks
meta.rule: A PINN estimator wins a window when every seed has a strictly lower Track B error than a single-valued comparator and loses when every seed is strictly higher; two PINN models are compared seed by seed (pairs by seed number); against the multi-seed LSTM every seed must lie below every LSTM seed. Otherwise the outcome is a tie. A diverged or failed run loses to every comparator; a comparison whose comparator diverged or failed is not decided. Observers are compared on the noise realisation the PINN was trained on (r = 0); rows marked * use more information and are never winners; two-seed and one-seed PINN rows are labelled and do not decide H1-H7.

H5.ratio: mean over the group of NRMSE(Ic) / NRMSE(Ie) per component, K0-A0; CL-PINN: per seed pair, then the median over the pairs
